'''Diamond boots''' are [[Armor#Boots|boots]] of the [[Diamond equipment|diamond]] tier, crafted from four [[diamond]]s.

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

=== Loot ===
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Armor ===
They give 3 armor and 2 toughness, with 800 durability instead of vanilla's 363 to 528. Every diamond piece gets the same durability. Diamond armor has the same armor values as [[Electrum equipment|electrum]] and [[Adamant equipment|adamant]]; the alloys add toughness, durability and intrinsics.

=== Repairing ===
They can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[diamond]]s. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so they can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting and smithing ===
{{Uses}}

They melt down into one diamond in a blast furnace and are the base for the electrum and adamant upgrades.
